milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing targeting the bell (the iconic village landmark at ~10,~0,~6) because the player must navigate into the village proper and face the central area to confirm they've found it. The bell is the most recognizable village-specific block. max_distance=10 ensures the player has walked forward from spawn toward the village buildings, and facing_tolerance=180 means any facing direction counts (just proximity to the village center).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The birch_wall_sign is at (~-2, ~2, ~6) on the south face of the main building. The player must be within 5 blocks and facing north (toward the sign on the south wall, yaw ~180°). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the building facade where the sign is mounted.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The blue_wall_banner is at (~8, ~2, ~4) on the south face of the east cobblestone building. The player must be within 6 blocks and facing toward the banner. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the cobblestone building's south facade where the blue banner is mounted.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The brown_wall_banner is at (~-11, ~2, ~-4) on the south face of the northwest oak log cabin. The player must be within 6 blocks and facing toward the banner. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the log cabin's south facade where the brown banner is mounted.
